ruby.name: Ruby (Manikya)
ruby.description: The king of gemstones, representing the life-giving energy of the Sun and the inner soul (Atman).
ruby.benefits: Enhances leadership, self-confidence, status, command, and willpower. Strengthens the bones, heart, and general physical vitality.
ruby.mythology: According to the Garuda Purana, Ruby was created from the blood of the cosmic demon Vala, which fell into the waters of Lanka. Surya Dev collected this blood, transforming it into Rubies filled with solar flame.
ruby.mantraSanskrit: ॐ ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रौं सः सूर्याय नमः
ruby.mantraTranslit: Om Hraam Hreem Hroum Sah Suryaya Namah
ruby.caution: Do not wear Ruby if you are wearing Blue Sapphire, Diamond, or Hessonite. The Sun has planetary enmity with Saturn, Venus, and Rahu.

pearl.name: Pearl (Moti)
pearl.description: The gemstone of the Moon, embodying the cooling, soothing qualities of the mind and emotions.
pearl.benefits: Cools anger, relieves stress and anxiety, improves emotional balance, and strengthens memory. Promotes happy maternal relationships and sound sleep.
pearl.mythology: Mythology tells us that Pearls are formed from the drops of celestial nectar or the cool, loving tears of the Moon God Chandra when he reflects upon the cosmic ocean.
pearl.mantraSanskrit: ॐ श्रां श्रीं श्रौं सः चन्द्रमसे नमः
pearl.mantraTranslit: Om Shram Shreem Shrom Sah Chandramase Namah
pearl.caution: Do not wear Pearl with Hessonite or Cat's Eye, as the Moon is hostile to the shadow nodes Rahu and Ketu.

coral.name: Red Coral (Moonga)
coral.description: The stone of Mars, radiating raw courage, metabolic energy, and physical strength.
coral.benefits: Banishes fear, overcomes procrastination, cures blood-related issues, boosts immunity, and protects from enemies or accidents.
coral.mythology: Mars was born from a drop of sweat from Lord Shiva's forehead during his cosmic dance, which fell onto the red soil. Coral represents Shiva's fiery, protector energy.
coral.mantraSanskrit: ॐ क्रां क्रीं क्रौं सः भौमाय नमः
coral.mantraTranslit: Om Kram Kreem Krom Sah Bhaumaya Namah
coral.caution: Do not wear Red Coral with Emerald. Mars and Mercury share mutual astrological opposition, which can cause erratic temperaments.

emerald.name: Emerald (Panna)
emerald.description: The stone of communication, commerce, and intellectual brilliance, ruled by Mercury.
emerald.benefits: Enhances speech, memory, analytical intelligence, business acumen, and mathematical ability. Excellent for scholars, speakers, and merchants.
emerald.mythology: Mercury is Budha, the son of Tara and Chandra, representing youth and wisdom. The emerald was created by Vishnu's protective, stabilizing gaze, capturing the growth essence of nature.
emerald.mantraSanskrit: ॐ ब्रां ब्रीं ब्रौं सः बुधाय नमः
emerald.mantraTranslit: Om Bram Breem Brom Sah Budhaya Namah
emerald.caution: Emerald should not be paired with Pearl, as Mercury holds Moon as a source of emotional instability and distraction.

yellow-sapphire.name: Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj)
yellow-sapphire.description: The stone of Jupiter, the Guru of the Devas, embodying wisdom, wealth, and spiritual growth.
yellow-sapphire.benefits: Attracts financial prosperity, professional success, wisdom, moral clarity, and martial bliss. Promotes good fortune and luck in all endeavors.
yellow-sapphire.mythology: Jupiter is Brihaspati, the master of counsel and sacred chanting. Yellow Sapphire reflects his golden light of wisdom, shielding the wearer from ignorance and misfortune.
yellow-sapphire.mantraSanskrit: ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरवे नमः
yellow-sapphire.mantraTranslit: Om Gram Greem Grom Sah Gurave Namah
yellow-sapphire.caution: Do not wear Yellow Sapphire with Diamond or Blue Sapphire. Jupiter holds Venus and Saturn as rivals in spiritual vs. material realms.

diamond.name: Diamond (Heera)
diamond.description: The gemstone of Venus, representing beauty, luxury, creative arts, and personal attraction.
diamond.benefits: Attracts wealth, luxurious living, artistic talent, charm, and happy relationships. Elevates social grace and creativity.
diamond.mythology: Venus is Shukra, the guru of the Asuras, who possesses the Sanjeevani Vidya (the secret to resurrecting the dead). Diamonds represent the pure, indestructible crystal fire of his knowledge.
diamond.finger: Right Hand Middle or Ring Finger
diamond.mantraSanskrit: ॐ द्रां द्रीं द्रौं सः शुक्राय नमः
diamond.mantraTranslit: Om Dram Dreem Drom Sah Shukraya Namah
diamond.caution: Avoid pairing Diamond with Ruby or Pearl, as the Sun and Moon are hostile to Shukra's material wealth domains.

blue-sapphire.name: Blue Sapphire (Neelam)
blue-sapphire.description: The most powerful, fastest-acting gemstone in Vedic astrology, representing discipline, justice, and karma.
blue-sapphire.benefits: Brings sudden wealth, fame, clarity of mind, and protection from negative energies. Clears persistent career obstacles and delays.
blue-sapphire.mythology: Shani Dev is the lord of justice, demanding discipline. Neelam is connected to his third-eye gaze, transforming karmic obstacles into lessons of humility and power.
blue-sapphire.mantraSanskrit: ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः
blue-sapphire.mantraTranslit: Om Pram Preem Prom Sah Shanaye Namah
blue-sapphire.caution: CRITICAL: Must test under pillow for 3 nights. Do not wear alongside Ruby, Pearl, or Red Coral. Saturn has intense enmity with Sun, Moon, and Mars.

hessonite.name: Hessonite (Gomed)
hessonite.description: The honey-colored stone representing the shadow planet Rahu, the driver of ambitions and illusions.
hessonite.benefits: Wards off evil spirits, protects from black magic, cures skin ailments, and brings sudden prosperity or political success.
hessonite.mythology: Rahu is the head of the demon Svarbhanu, severed during the churning of the cosmic ocean (Samudra Manthan). Hessonite was formed from his eyes, carrying the power of desire and cosmic drive.
hessonite.mantraSanskrit: ॐ भ्रां भ्रीं भ्रौं सः राहवे नमः
hessonite.mantraTranslit: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhrom Sah Rahave Namah
hessonite.caution: Do not wear with Ruby or Pearl, as Rahu is the eternal eclipse-creator of the Sun and Moon.

cats-eye.name: Cat's Eye (Lehsuniya)
cats-eye.description: The chatoyant gemstone of Ketu, the shadow node of detachment, intuition, and spiritual liberation.
cats-eye.benefits: Protects from hidden enemies, accidents, and negative spectral forces. Restores lost wealth and sharpens spiritual intuition/meditation.
cats-eye.mythology: Ketu is the tail of the demon Svarbhanu, representing the path to Moksha (liberation). The glowing stripe of Cat's Eye represents the spiritual light leading out of darkness.
cats-eye.finger: Right Hand Middle or Ring Finger
cats-eye.mantraSanskrit: ॐ स्त्रां स्त्रीं स्त्रौं सः केतवे नमः
cats-eye.mantraTranslit: Om Stram Streem Strom Sah Ketave Namah
cats-eye.caution: Do not wear alongside Ruby or Pearl. Ketu eclipse energies conflict deeply with the solar and lunar lights.
